app.title: Cafeteria management
error.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
home.title: Home
home.empty: No data yet. Start by importing the families file.
import.title: Import the families file
import.help: Import the CSV export of the families software (columns “NUMFAM”, “NOMFACT”, “EMAIL PAYEUR”), or an Excel file (.xlsx) with the columns “nom parent”, “nom enfant” and “adresse email” (or “parent name”, “child name”, “email”). Other columns are ignored.
import.replace_note: The file replaces the current data: whatever is missing from the file will be deleted. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.error.format: Only .csv and Excel .xlsx files are accepted. In Excel: File › Save As › Excel Workbook (.xlsx).
import.error.too_large: The file is too large (maximum %d MB).
import.error.unreadable: This file cannot be read. Check that it is a .csv or Excel .xlsx file.
import.error.too_many_columns: The file has too many columns. Check that it is a valid .csv file.
import.error.missing_columns: Columns not found: %s. Check the first row of the file.
import.error.stale: The data changed since this check (another import was saved). Import the file again to see up-to-date changes.
import.error.expired: The check has expired. Please import the file again.
import.issue.parent_name_conflict: Same email as an earlier row but another parent name (%s): the first name is kept
preview.title: File check
preview.no_changes: The file is identical to the current data.
preview.errors_help: Fix these rows in the Excel file, then import it again. Nothing can be saved while errors remain.
preview.deleted_help: These children are in the app but no longer in the file. The history of sent emails is kept.
children.title: Children
children.empty: Nothing to select yet. Import the families file first.
children.error.too_large: The submitted selection is too large.
compose.title: Recipients
compose.emails_count: %d email(s) will be sent, one per parent.
compose.dropped: %d selected row(s) no longer exist (an import happened in between) and were ignored.
compose.next_step: Writing the message comes in the next step.
import.issue.billing_name_conflict: Same family and email as an earlier row but another billing name (%s): the first one is kept
import.issue.invalid_payer_email: Invalid payer email: %s. The family is imported but cannot be emailed at this address.
preview.confirm_deletions_families: Confirm import and delete %d family row(s)
children.no_email_notice: %d row(s) without a valid email address: they cannot be selected. Fix the file, then import it again.
children.error.no_email: The selection contains a family without a valid email address.
compose.emails_count_families: %d email(s) will be sent, one per address.
